_doc: Source of the component catalog. README.md is generated from it by scripts/ux-catalog.mjs (node scripts/ux-catalog.mjs; --check fails when stale or inconsistent). swift = path under Sources/Agentico + line range. variants = 'id|note'; 'default' is the bare crop ref/<Name>.png, others ref/<Name>.<id>.png (a variant with no crop in crops.json says so in the README). rnToday = file implementing it now ('none' = no RN equivalent). Targets live in packages/ui/src/components/<Name>.tsx.

home-shell.title: Home cards, sessions, FAB, large title

nav-sheets.title: Toolbars, sidebar, sheet headers, empty detail, scanner, key/value groups

agent-bar.title: Agent detail header, switcher, drawer, composer, status line, change rows

chat-rows.title: Chat timeline rows and diff rows

blocked-terminal.title: Blocked card, background work, banners, jump control, terminal toolbar and keys

usage.title: Usage chips, totals, charts, heat map, breakdown

hosts-settings-files.title: Host, settings, theme, file and port rows

settings-pickers.title: Terminal palette, agent list fields, overlay peer picker and port preview

composer-extras.title: Skills pane and content sheet, attachment staging bar, subagent transcript

components.name: AgentCard
variants: default|Blocked: program mark with red dot, red mono prompt line with a ? bubble, +N -N diff counts
working|Working capsule, plain subtitle
idle-context|Idle capsule plus the amber low-context pill (16 %)
wide|iPad sidebar width (332), same layout
components.interactions: tap opens detail; swipe leading Pin (full swipe), trailing Close (full swipe); long press opens AgentRowMenu with the card lifted; hover/selected fill on iPad; Saved capsule for disconnected Hosts
components.props: { agent: AgentCardModel (title, program, status, blockedPrompt?, subtitle, host, path, diff?, contextLeft?, saved?), selected?, onPress, menu, swipe* }
accept: title row: program mark, bold title, secondary program name, trailing status Badge wash
Blocked shows the red mono prompt line with its bubble icon under the title
meta row: subtitle left, Host right, path and +N -N counts on the third line
context-low pill sits left of the status capsule
row hairline separators on the flat list, card with hairline on workspace and board

components.name: FoldHeader
variants: status|'Needs you 1' count capsule, trailing chevron
workspace|headline workspace name with the Host in secondary after it (the Terminals list), trailing chevron
host|Host glyph + name + readiness text or status count pills when collapsed
inbox|Home section title with count, no chevron
see-all|footer line '1 idle' with accent 'See all'
components.interactions: tap folds/unfolds with a snappy spring and chevron turn; a Host that cannot connect opens its connection sheet instead; disabled while searching
components.props: { kind: 'status'|'host'|'inbox'|'footer', title, count?, hostStatus?, readiness?, pills?, collapsed?, onToggle?, onSeeAll? }
accept: title in secondary subheadline weight, count in a rounded capsule
chevron rotates 90 degrees on fold
collapsed Host shows count pills (2 working, 1 blocked) in status colors
footer variant: secondary text left, accent See all right

components.name: WorkspaceCard
variants: default|Workspace header (folder icon, name, Host and path, fold chip with count) then nested agent rows
components.interactions: tap header folds the card; linked git worktrees nest under their repository checkout; checkout header opens worktree details
components.props: { workspace: { title, host, path, agentCount, collapsed }, children: AgentCard[], onToggle, onOpen }
accept: one rounded card per workspace on the page background, hairline border
header: folder icon, bold name, secondary Host and path line, count chip with chevron on the right
agent rows inside the card keep the AgentCard layout without their own card
gap between cards equals airy.sectionGap

components.name: TerminalRow
variants: default|rounded card per workspace: terminal tile icon, mono title, mono path, chevron, '+ New Terminal' footer row
tile|session tile used by the Home Sessions strip
components.interactions: tap opens the shell; swipe Close; long press menu; New Terminal row opens the form sheet
components.props: { terminal: { title, path, host }, onPress, menu, swipe }, <TerminalGroup title host> wrapper with the New Terminal row
accept: leading rounded-square tile with a terminal glyph
title mono headline, path mono caption in secondary
chevron trailing, hairline between rows inside the card
last row '+ New Terminal' in secondary with a plus

components.name: AgentRowMenu
variants: default|long-press: the card lifts at full width above a glass menu (Pin, Details, Close Pane in red)
components.interactions: long press lifts the row, haptic, menu items with icon, destructive in red, dismiss on tap outside; same actions as accessibility actions
components.props: { preview: ReactNode, items: ActionMenuItem[] } over ActionMenu
accept: the pressed card stays visible above the menu at card width
menu rows: accent icon left, label, destructive row red below a divider
glass/blurred menu surface with the card radius

components.name: HostIssueRow
variants: default|compact amber row (wifi-slash glyph + '<Host> is offline'); several Hosts become one summary row
components.interactions: tap opens the Host connection sheet or the Hosts tab on that Host; hidden while searching
components.props: { issues: { hostName, kind, message }[], onOpen }
accept: amber glyph and amber-tinted text, no card, sits above the first section
two issues stack as two compact lines; three or more collapse to one summary row

components.name: InboxCard
variants: default|Needs you: red ring card, title + age, prompt in secondary, two mono chips (Host, directory)
working|same card without the ring, orange orb on the program mark
components.interactions: tap opens detail; long press opens the quick-detail sheet; selected state on iPad
components.props: { presentation: { title, subtitle, age, chips[], section: 'needsYou'|'working'|'done' }, selected?, onPress, onLongPress }
accept: Needs you card has a 1pt status-red ring, radius 8
title headline semibold, age trailing caption in secondary
chips mono caption2 in capsules with a hairline
card height and inner padding airy (x1.3 of Swift)

components.name: SessionsStrip
variants: default|header 'Sessions 5' + See all; horizontal strip of tiles (icon, mono name) with the title and Host captions below each tile
snapshots|RN addition: each tile shows the last lines of its pane (PaneSnapshot) in the terminal theme; no See all
components.interactions: horizontal scroll with snap; tap opens the session; See all opens the Agents list
components.props: { sessions: { id, kind: 'agent'|'shell', name, title, host, status? }[], onOpen, onSeeAll }
accept: tiles about 130 wide, 90 tall in the Swift atlas, rounded 8 with hairline
tile: small kind glyph top-left, mono name bottom-left
caption row under the tile: program mark + title, Host below in secondary
the strip bleeds to the screen edge and the next tile peeks

components.name: HomeHostCard
variants: default|circle glyph, Host name, mono address, trailing readiness text with a status dot (No Agents, Sync issue)
components.interactions: tap opens the Host connection sheet; long press menu
components.props: { host: { name, address, readiness, tone }, onPress }
accept: leading 40pt circle with the Host glyph
name headline, address mono caption truncated in the middle
trailing readiness caption with a tone dot above it

components.name: UsageRing
variants: default|ring with percentage inside (48), accent for the worst window; replaced by a bar glyph when no limits
components.interactions: tap opens the Usage quick sheet
components.props: { percent: number | null, tone?: 'ok'|'warn'|'critical', onPress }
accept: 22pt ring, 3pt stroke, rounded caps, track at 25 percent opacity
number in caption2 semibold centered
sits in the glass capsule next to Settings

components.name: Fab
variants: default|56pt accent circle with a plus, soft accent glow, bottom right
components.interactions: tap opens the New menu (New Agent, New Terminal, Add Host); haptic light; hides while a sheet is up
components.props: { onPress, items: ActionMenuItem[] }
accept: accent fill, plus glyph in accent-foreground, diameter 56
shadow/glow in accent at 35 percent
bottom inset = safe area + 16, right inset = screenInset

components.name: LargeTitleBar
variants: default|34pt bold large title left, glass capsule on the right with the actions
leading|RN addition: no title, a capsule of All Agents and Sessions at the leading edge
components.interactions: title collapses into a small centered title on scroll; capsule buttons have haptics
components.props: { title, actions: { icon, label, onPress }[] }
accept: title largeTitle bold, left aligned at screenInset
capsule height 44, buttons 40 wide, accent icons
background is the ScreenBackground glow, no opaque bar

components.name: ListToolbar
variants: default|Home button in its own circle at left; at right one glass capsule with Host filter, Presentation and New (+)
components.interactions: Presentation menu switches flat / By Host / By Status / By Workspace; Host filter menu; + opens New Agent
components.props: { onHome, filter, presentation, onNew }
accept: left circle (home, accent), right capsule three accent icons
the Presentation icon changes with the active mode
no opaque navigation bar; large title below

components.name: SidebarColumn
variants: default|floating rounded glass column: title menu 'Agents v', + and hide-sidebar buttons, search field, list, footer with Hosts and Settings at left and Presentation/Host filter at right
components.interactions: title menu switches Agents/Terminals; edge swipe reveals; search field is always visible on iPad; selected row fill
components.props: { title menu, search, children, footer actions }
accept: column about 330 wide with radius 24 and a hairline, inset from the screen edges
header row then the search pill then the list, footer icons at the bottom
detail column to the right shows EmptyDetail when nothing is selected

components.name: EmptyDetail
variants: default|stacked windows glyph, 'No Agent Selected', explanation, tinted 'New Agent' capsule with the shortcut hint
components.interactions: button opens New Agent (cmd+N)
components.props: { icon, title, message, action?: { label, shortcut?, onPress } }
accept: icon 48pt secondary, title title3 bold, message callout secondary max width 420
action is an accent-wash capsule, not a solid button

components.name: QuickSheetHeader
variants: default|grabber, bold title left, circular close button right
detail|grabber, program line 'Codex - Working' with age, large title, chips
components.interactions: drag on the grabber resizes between detents; close button dismisses; haptic on detent change
rnToday: packages/ui/src/overlay/Sheet.tsx (bar actions exist, no quick header)
components.props: { title, onClose, subtitle?, trailing? } inside Sheet
accept: grabber 36x5 centered 6pt from the top
title title2 bold, close = 32pt circle with an x in secondary
sheet top radius 28, content inset screenInset

components.name: SearchBar
variants: default|search field with a glass close circle at its right; replaces the toolbar and title while searching
components.interactions: the field filters live; the circle leaves search mode and clears the query
components.props: { label, value, onChangeText, onClose, closeLabel?, clearLabel? }
accept: 44pt glass circle with an x, 8pt gap to the field
field fills the rest of the row and takes focus when the bar appears

components.name: TextPromptSheet
variants: default|Cancel and Save in the sheet bar, centered title, one text field, a footnote hint under it
components.interactions: Save (or return) hands the text over, an empty text is valid; Cancel and a backdrop tap dismiss
components.props: { visible, title, fieldLabel, initialValue?, hint?, cancelLabel?, saveLabel?, onSave, onClose }
accept: the field opens focused with the initial text
hint in footnote secondary, closing sentence with a period

components.name: ConnectionSheet
variants: default|Host name title, Edit in the bar, state line with attempt, mono routes, failure headline and detail, Retry Now and Stop Connecting
components.interactions: Retry Now restarts the connection, Stop Connecting stops a dial in flight, Edit opens the Host form
components.props: { visible, title, state: { icon, label, note? }, detail?, failure?: { title, detail }, primary, secondary?, edit?, onClose }
accept: state line: glyph, semibold label, secondary note
routes and failure detail in mono footnote
primary action pinned at the bottom with the text action under it

components.name: ScannerFrame
variants: unavailable|camera glyph, 'Scanning Unavailable', Paste Pairing Code and Add Manually (the only state the simulator atlas has; the live frame with corner brackets has no crop)
components.interactions: camera preview with corner brackets and a hint; Cancel at left; Paste Pairing Code as a capsule; torch toggle
components.props: { state: 'scanning'|'unavailable'|'denied', onCode, onPaste, onManual }
accept: scanning: square viewfinder with four accent corner brackets, dim outside the square
unavailable: icon, title, message, filled capsule primary, plain accent secondary
Cancel in the bar, title 'Scan to Pair' centered

components.name: KeyValueGroup
variants: default|section title above a rounded card of rows: label left, value right in secondary, optional copy glyph
components.interactions: tap a value copies it with a toast; long values wrap right aligned
components.props: { title?, rows: { label, value, mono?, copy? }[] }
accept: labels body primary, values body secondary right aligned
hairline between rows inset by screenInset
mono values for ids, paths and hashes

components.name: AgentHeader
variants: default|two glass circles (sidebar/session drawer at left, more (...) at right) with the mid-bar identity between them: eyebrow HOST · AGENT KIND, bold mono title, mono workspace · branch subtitle (optional props eyebrow, title, subtitle)
components.interactions: left opens the SessionDrawer, right opens the header menu (Chat/Terminal toggle, Changes, Files, Ports, Rename, Close); edge swipe back
components.props: { onSidebar, menu: ActionMenuItem[], surface: 'chat'|'terminal' }
accept: circles 44pt, glass fill with hairline, 12pt from the safe area top
content scrolls under them with a top fade

components.name: AgentSwitcher
variants: default|glass capsule at the bottom: other agents as faded chips, the current one as a filled pill with its mark and orb, trailing surface/keyboard toggles
tools|extra trailing icons (compose, skills, keyboard)
components.interactions: tap a chip switches agent with a haptic; horizontal scroll, current pill stays centered; trailing icons toggle the keys dock and the keyboard
components.props: { agents: { id, title, program, status }[], currentId, onSelect, trailing: { icon, onPress, active }[] }
accept: capsule height 44 over the keyboard dock, 12pt side inset
current agent is a pill with a lighter fill, mark with status orb, 'Title - Program'
neighbours are secondary and clipped at the capsule edge

components.name: SessionDrawer
variants: default|left drawer over a dimmed detail: search pill + two toggle buttons, Host line with counts and +, Workspaces with fold rows and the selected row in an accent wash
components.interactions: opens from the header button or an edge swipe; tap a row switches; fold per workspace; search filters workspaces, tabs and panes; swipe left to close
components.props: { host line, workspaces: { title, branch?, items: { id, kind, title, age, status }[] }[], selectedId, onSelect }
accept: drawer about 330 wide, radius 24 on the free edge, glass surface
selected row has an accent wash at 25 percent and its age in secondary
group headers bold with a count at the right

components.name: ComposerCard
variants: default|one line: + circle, agent mark circle, placeholder, stop (red) or send (white arrow) circle at right
expanded|multi-line input above a button row: +, agent, more (...), spacer, stop/send
skills|suggestion panel above the input (SKILLS header, close, mono name + description rows)
components.interactions: grows with text up to 6 lines; + opens Add File/Add Image menu; more menu (Paste, Snippets, Clear); send is disabled when empty; stop while working; slash opens skills
components.props: { value, onChange, working, onSend, onStop, leading: ReactNode, suggestions?, agent: ProgramMark props }
accept: rounded 28 glass card with a hairline, 12pt inset, floating above the switcher
stop is a red filled circle with a white square, send a white circle with a dark arrow
button row circles are 40pt in a secondary fill
skills panel mono names in primary, descriptions secondary, hairlines between

components.name: StatusLine
variants: default|status dot + 'Working' (orange), branch with arrows, ahead/behind counters, +N -N, latency at right
low-context|Idle and the amber '16 % context left' pill
components.interactions: tap opens Changes; hidden when no data
components.props: { status, branch?, counts?, diff?, contextLeft?, latencyMs?, onOpenChanges }
accept: one line caption mono-ish, truncating the branch first
status colors from tokens, +N green and -N red
sits directly above the ComposerCard, 12pt side inset

components.name: ChangeRow
variants: summary|card: repo name + Worktree capsule + totals, branch with counters, last commit line, 'Possibly incomplete - Read at'
file|file name, directory in secondary, +N -N and a colored kind letter (M)
components.interactions: tap a file opens the diff; section header 'CHANGES 2' uppercase; long press reference menu
components.props: { summary | file: { name, dir, added, removed, kind, staged }, onPress }
accept: summary card with Worktree capsule next to the repo name, totals right aligned
file rows inside one card with hairlines, kind letter amber for M, green A, red D
section header caption uppercase with the count at the right

components.name: ChatUserBubble
variants: default|right aligned rounded bubble in the secondary surface, max 80 percent width
pending|dimmed with a sending spinner
components.interactions: long press: copy, select text; attachments render as chips under the text
components.props: { text, attachments?, pending? }
accept: bubble radius 20, surface fill, no border, body text primary
aligned to the right with 16pt trailing inset, assistant text has no bubble

components.name: ChatDivider
variants: turn|'Worked for 26s >' collapsible turn header
working|'Working for 1:45' with a live timer
compacted|centered 'Context compacted' between hairlines
components.interactions: tap on the turn header folds the turn's tools; timer ticks each second
components.props: { kind: 'turn'|'working'|'compacted', label, collapsed?, onToggle? }
accept: footnote secondary text, chevron after the label for turn
compacted: label centered between two hairlines, caption2

components.name: ChatThoughtRow
variants: default|brain glyph, 'Thought for 4s', chevron; expands to the reasoning text in secondary
components.interactions: tap expands inline
components.props: { seconds, text?, expanded, onToggle }
accept: subheadline secondary, glyph 16pt, chevron right of the label
expanded text indented under the glyph

components.name: ChatToolRow
variants: default|tool card: kind icon, mono command (2 lines), trailing status (Exit 1 red)
waiting|orange hand glyph 'Waiting', command line in secondary
subagents|group of subagent rows: icon, name, kind, check or spinner, 'Open Subagent Transcript' link
components.interactions: tap expands output; subagent rows open the transcript; long press copy
components.props: { tool: { kind, title, detail, status, exitCode? }, expanded, onToggle }
accept: card radius 8 on the secondary surface, mono footnote command
status at the right in its tone (red x Exit 1, orange Waiting, green check)
subagent group: one card per row, link row with a chevron

components.name: ChatNoticeRow
variants: default|bell glyph, 'Agent "X" completed' title and a caption line below
components.interactions: none (informational)
components.props: { icon, title, detail }
accept: subheadline secondary title with a 16pt glyph, caption2 detail indented
no background

components.name: DiffRow
variants: default|file bar (kind badge, 'Modified - Unstaged', +1 -1), hunk band, numbered lines with +/- gutters and word highlights, 'unchanged lines' gap
components.interactions: long press a line: reference menu; tap a gap expands; side-by-side on wide
components.props: { file, hunks, layout: 'unified'|'sideBySide', onReference }
accept: added lines green wash with a green gutter +, removed red wash
changed words get a stronger wash
line numbers in secondary mono, 2 columns
hunk band caption mono on the surface fill with the gap count at the right

components.name: BlockedCard
variants: default|header (hand glyph, 'Bash command', chevron), description, code box, filled accent 'Yes', secondary option, red 'No', 'Add a Note'
collapsed|single bar with the title and a chevron (no atlas crop)
question|form card with options and a text field (no atlas crop)
components.interactions: option tap sends the key and haptics; chevron collapses; Add a Note opens a text field; rule warning line under rules
components.props: { prompt: BlockedPrompt (title, description, code?, options[], warning?), onChoose, onNote, collapsed }
accept: card radius 20 over the composer area, hairline
Yes: solid accent button full width, other options secondary fill, No red wash
warning line amber with a triangle glyph
code box mono footnote on the darker surface

components.name: BackgroundWorkStrip
variants: default|collapsed pill: spinner, '1 running - Find other retry callers', chevron
expanded|card with up to 3 rows (spinner, name, kind, progress 2/3, time) and '+1 more'
components.interactions: tap opens the background work sheet; rows update live
components.props: { items: { id, title, kind, state, progress?, elapsed }[], onOpen }
accept: pill radius 14 on the secondary surface above the composer
running rows with the accent spinner, finished with a check
+N more in accent bold

components.name: NoticeBanner
variants: default|in-chat banner: warning glyph, message, accent Retry
locating|centered spinner + 'Looking for the conversation...'
inapp|top-of-screen notification banner (no atlas crop)
components.interactions: Retry re-reads; the in-app banner taps into the agent and swipes up to dismiss
components.props: { tone, icon?, message, action?: { label, onPress } }
accept: rounded 16 secondary surface, glyph left, message subheadline, action accent semibold at the right
locating: spinner above 17pt secondary text, centered in the free area

components.name: JumpControl
screens: agent-detail.chat (appears when scrolled away; no atlas crop)
variants: default|floating glass circle with a chevron-down (jump to latest), up/down message jump pair on long press
components.interactions: tap jumps to latest with a haptic; long press expands to previous/next user message; fades after 2 s idle
components.props: { visible, onJumpLatest, onPrevious, onNext }
accept: 40pt glass circle at the trailing edge above the composer
appears only when more than one screen from the bottom

components.name: TerminalToolbar
variants: default|capsule: agent mark, Ctrl, Esc, Tab, arrows glyph, keyboard, more
dock|same capsule without the agent mark (shell)
dpad|long press on the arrows glyph lifts a d-pad popover (up, left, enter, right, down)
components.interactions: Ctrl is a sticky modifier (second tap locks); keys repeat on hold; d-pad drag-to-direction; More opens snippets, paste, clear
components.props: { keys: KeySpec[], modifiers, onKey, leading?: ReactNode, onMore }
accept: pill capsule 52 tall, mono semibold key labels, 20pt gaps
armed modifier turns accent
d-pad popover is a rounded 28 glass shape above the arrows glyph

components.name: KeyPad
variants: default|3x4 grid of key caps (Esc Tab Backspace, arrows, Shift-Tab, Enter) under an Agent / Terminal pager; bottom tab bar of pages (keys, skills, snippets, appearance)
components.interactions: tap sends; hold repeats; swipe between Agent and Terminal pages; page tab bar switches panes
components.props: { pages, keys, onKey }
accept: key caps radius 12 on the elevated surface, 8pt gaps
pager title selected primary, other secondary with a dot indicator
bottom page tab bar with the active tab in an accent wash

components.name: UsageLimitChip
variants: default|ring with percent, Host dot + name, 'Codex - Weekly'; horizontal strip, next chip peeks
components.interactions: tap opens the limits sheet; strip scrolls; 'Details' accent link in the header
components.props: { percent, host, program, window, tone }
accept: chip radius 14 on the secondary surface, 44pt ring left
two text lines: Host with dot (caption), program and window (headline)
ring tone warn/critical from tokens

components.name: ProviderUsageCard
variants: default|one card per provider and Host: mark, name, Host, chevron, a LimitWindowRow per window; a note instead of windows when off or unavailable
components.interactions: tap opens the provider's detail; ProviderUsageFooter ('Updated this minute' with a status dot) closes the stack
components.props: { program, brand, name, hostName, windows, note?, onPress? }
accept: bars take the provider's brand token tint (programTint), never a literal
one card per registered provider (packages/core/src/usage/providers); adding a provider adds no UI

components.name: LimitWindowRow
variants: default|label, 10-segment bar with a partial last segment, percent, time to reset
components.interactions: none
components.props: { label, usedShare, color, percentText, resetText }
accept: segments fill left to right: whole ones, then one partial, track in the control token
percent and reset right-aligned in tabular figures

components.name: UsageTotals
variants: default|two segmented controls (Est. Cost / Tokens, Today / 7 Days / 30 Days), caption, big currency total, tokens line
day|date title, nav arrows and close, total and tokens for that day
components.interactions: segments animate the selection pill; scope menu pill 'All Hosts' filters; day arrows step days
components.props: { metric, range, total, tokens, scope, onChange* }
accept: total in a 44pt bold rounded numeric style

caption secondary above, tokens subheadline secondary below

components.name: UsageChart
variants: default|smoothed area+line per program (orange fill, white line), legend with dots, 'Hold to read a day', y labels US$ 0/2/4, x dates
components.interactions: press and hold scrubs a day with a vertical rule and readout, haptic per day
components.props: { series: { program, color, points[] }[], onSelectDay }
accept: rounded card, legend row at the top, y axis labels at the right

components.name: UsageHeatMap
variants: default|month header, weekday letters, 7-column grid of rounded cells with grayscale intensity
full|expanded calendar with Less ... More legend, Today ring and hatched Not recorded

unrecorded days hatched, today outlined
legend row: Less, 5 swatches, More; Today and Not recorded keys

components.name: UsageBreakdownRow
variants: default|program dot + name, cost right, tokens secondary, stacked split bar (input, cache read, cache write, output) and a legend
host|Host glyph, name, date and zone caption, cost and tokens

components.name: HostRow
